description: This file defines FastAPI routes for user-related operations such as registration, login, profile retrieval, and updates. It includes helper functions for converting User models to output schemas and interacts with a database using SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User database model representing users in the system.

methods.name: UserOut _user_to_out(u: User)
methods.description: Converts a User object to a UserOut schema, parsing JSON fields for bookmarks and preferences.

methods.name: register(payload: UserRegisterIn)
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, ensuring email uniqueness, hashing the password, and adding the user to the database.

methods.name: login(payload: UserLoginIn)
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user, verify credentials, and generate an access token.

methods.name: get_profile(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"))
methods.description: Retrieves a user's profile by ID, returning the UserOut schema.

methods.name: patch_profile(id: int, payload: UserProfileUpdateIn, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates user profile fields like preferences and bookmarks, with access control.

methods.name: update_preferences(payload: Dict[str, Any], user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the preferences of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: get_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_profile(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID")):$/

ctags.name: patch_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def patch_profile(id: int, payload: UserProfileUpdateIn, user=Depends(get_current_user)):$/
